title: JSON Formatter
h1: JSON Formatter — Pretty Print and Validate JSON
seoTitle: JSON Formatter — Free Online JSON Beautifier
description: Format, validate and minify JSON instantly in your browser. Pretty-print with indentation or compress to a single line. Private and free.
intro: Paste any JSON and format it with proper indentation, or minify it. The tool checks for syntax errors and shows them clearly. Everything runs locally.
blurb: Pretty-print or minify JSON and catch syntax errors — free, private, no upload.
howItWorks: Paste or type JSON into the input box.
Choose indentation and click Format or Minify.
Valid JSON appears in the output. Errors are reported in the status area.
examples: Format a minified API response to make it readable.
Validate a configuration file before committing it.
Minify JSON to reduce size for embedding or transmission.

faq.a: No. Parsing and formatting happen entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
The tool shows a clear error message with the approximate location of the problem.
